attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Hawaii military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. National Guard/Reserve pay exempt up to $8,636 (2025). Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per HI Rev. Stat. § 235-7 (2025).

Calculates Hawaii state income tax per Form N-11. Hawaii uses progressive tax brackets (12 brackets from 1.40% to 11.00%) with standard deductions and personal exemptions. Starting with federal AGI, applies Hawaii-specific deductions, standard deduction or itemized deductions, personal exemptions, and calculates tax using progressive brackets based on filing status.
